mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in less than 40% of triggered instances, or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% indicate broad consumer demand weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 1.5% annualized signals robust manufacturing expansion that supports corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in less than 55% of instances with INDPRO growth > 1.5%, or average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent price pressures that may trigger Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 45% of triggered instances, or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly employment growth below 50k (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signal labor market contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 55% of instances with INDPRO rising, or average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.0% signals weakening consumer demand for housing, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in less than 40% of triggered instances, or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
